data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 557 reported a net prior year reserve release of GBP 3.7 million in 2017, representing a 13.4% release against its opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was attributed to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years. The 2017 year of account was significantly impacted by an active catastrophe environment, with events such as Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, and wildfires in California, causing significant losses to the account.
